gate_obligations: Each topic must acquire version/configuration-specific claim evidence and an executable check where applicable, or an explicit bounded non-applicability classification. Presence of a case source is not evidence it passed.
Attach official regression results, including adaptations, unsupported cases and expected/extra diagnostics. Never substitute REXX process exit for per-case verdicts.
Compile and execute complete replacement instructional examples; retain original artifacts and classify fragments/deliberately invalid examples. Original prior-example audit wrappers are adaptations.
Require fresh independent combined-feature exercise results; predictions alone are not execution evidence.

Record matching cell widths, checked/release profiles, optimization levels and process-limited hazardous probes. Rehash toolchain sources, headers, configuration, cases and expected results on relevant changes.
Resolve required consequential semantic questions and bound compiler/document defects before enabling any AMXX research.
independent_exercise_status: predictions retained from earlier independent reviewer; source/config-hashed execution results not reviewed in this inventory task
